scope: NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL live, historical, market, settlement, weather, news and governed web-research sources relevant to PhilthySports/PhilthyParleys.

providers.name: ESPN Site API
providers.purpose: Scores, schedules, injuries, current headlines and selected settlement
providers.note: Existing adapters retained. Retrieved prose is evidence only and is not automatically a model feature.

providers.name: NBA CDN LiveData / nba_api
providers.purpose: NBA live scoreboard/box scores plus historical team and player game logs
providers.note: nba_api historical collectors include team and player game logs. Historical values still require point-in-time canonicalization before training.

providers.name: MLB StatsAPI
providers.purpose: Schedules, live scores, probable pitchers, player/game data, venue coordinates and settlement
providers.note: Official structured MLB path. Optional bounded pybaseball/Statcast acquisition is research evidence until canonicalized.

providers.name: NHL Web API
providers.purpose: Schedule, live game centre, box scores/statistics and settlement
providers.note: Current NHL Web API is used directly; historical feature acquisition can capture schedule and game-centre box scores in bounded windows.

providers.name: nflreadpy / nflverse
providers.purpose: Historical schedules, team/player stats, injuries, weekly rosters, depth charts, snaps, participation, play-by-play and advanced statistics
providers.note: Rich historical acquisition is configured. Historical availability alone is not evidence that a value was known at a specific prediction time; canonical observed_at reconstruction is required.

providers.name: pybaseball / Baseball Savant / FanGraphs
providers.note: Acquisition windows are bounded. Raw rows are not promotion evidence until point-in-time feature construction and canonical admission succeed.

providers.name: US National Weather Service
providers.note: Default weather provider. Excludes past events, stale forecasts and unconfirmed outdoor venues.

providers.name: Open-Meteo
providers.note: Set OPEN_METEO_ACCESS=noncommercial only for eligible non-commercial use. Off by default. No historical model features are inferred from current forecasts.

providers.name: DraftKings / Bovada public feeds
providers.purpose: Current game odds and selected player props
providers.note: Existing adapters retained. Coverage, timestamps and complementary prices remain checked per event and market.

providers.name: The Odds API v4
providers.purpose: Current credentialed odds/props plus optional paid historical market snapshots
providers.note: Current live coverage remains optional. Historical featured and event-level market capture is configured as dry-run by default and requires explicit ODDS_HISTORICAL_BACKFILL_ENABLED=true plus execution acknowledgement because historical calls consume paid quota.

providers.name: ScrapeGraphAI V2
providers.purpose: Public-web pregame research for injuries, availability, lineups, depth charts, starting pitchers/goalies and role changes
providers.note: Search/extract/scrape are configured through the fixed V2 API host. Output is always evidence-only, trusted_for_instructions=false, used_in_prediction=false and historical_training_eligible=false until a separately versioned numeric feature passes canonical admission. Crawl/monitor are intentionally not exposed.

providers.name: APILayer Weatherstack
providers.note: Requires an account key and suitable forecast entitlement; does not remove key dependence. NWS used instead.

providers.name: APILayer Mediastack
providers.note: Requires a provider key; current sports headlines are available through ESPN and governed web research. Not a replacement for authenticated private social feeds.

providers.name: BALLDONTLIE
providers.note: Current documentation requires API access and product-specific entitlements; it is not treated as a free replacement source.

providers.name: TheSportsDB
providers.note: Metadata option, not verified sportsbook player-prop coverage or a production shared-key solution.

providers.name: Odds-API.io
providers.note: Separate provider from The Odds API. Requires its own key, schema adapter and live coverage validation.

providers.name: FanLine Wire public snapshot
providers.note: Free rows lack enough stable selection/line/time information for safe production market mapping.

providers.name: Third-party public forecasts
providers.note: External predictions are not PhilthySports trained weights, chronological settled validation or calibrated promotion evidence.

credential_remediation.runtime_provider_keys: ODDS_API_KEY and SGAI_API_KEY are server-side optional integrations. Their presence is not inferred from source code.
credential_remediation.paid_historical_odds: Historical Odds API entitlement is not assumed. Backfill is dry-run and disabled by default.
credential_remediation.legacy_keys: Any previously exposed provider/service-account/social/Twilio credentials remain retired until provider-side rotation/revocation is independently verified.
credential_remediation.signing: Preserve the existing Android/model signing identity and zero-trust control plane.
